column1: # What the lemmas of the English lexicon mean in Russian: the glossary of
# this pack, loaded with it by `hilvan load-pack`.
# One line for every lemma of lexicons/en/lexicon.tsv, in its order. A gloss
# is the commonest senses, commonest first: senses apart with "; ", words of
# one sense with ", ", a note in brackets where a sense needs one. A word the
# pack teaches keeps the gloss of its [[word]] - the sense its sentences use;
# this file says what every other word of the language means, for the reader
# and for a word put into the deck from a text.
# Written once by a language model (Claude) from the list of lemmas on
# 2026-10-26, and corrected by hand since: it is edited here, not generated
# again. MIT, like the rest of the pack.
